zh.title: popover · 补充说明不占版面

items.label: 什么是白名单
items.content: 渲染器只认已注册的节点类型，遇到未知类型会告警并丢弃该节点，不会执行任意 HTML。

items.label: 悬停试试
items.content: 悬停触发同样支持 Escape 关闭与焦点返回。

items.label: What is a whitelist
items.content: The renderer only accepts registered node types; an unknown type warns and drops that node instead of running arbitrary HTML.

items.label: Try hovering
items.content: Hover triggering also supports Escape to close and focus restoration.
